hotels.title: Oceanfront Palau Island Paradise with Daily Breakfast, US$200 Resort Credit & Complimentary Minibar
hotels.description: Some escapes deserve a place on your bucket list - and this untouched paradise in Micronesia is one of them. Set against the emerald waters of the Pacific Ocean, Palau is easily accessible via direct flights from Brisbane, landing you on the island's gorgeous shores within six hours. Savour Chinese dining packed with fresh seafood at Moonshadow, dine with ocean views and internationally inspired flavours at Starlight Cafe, and lounge with a cocktail by the infinity pool at the Pool Side Lounge. When it's time to unwind, relax with soothing treatments at Yue Spa. When it’s time to explore, the hotel’s prime location makes it easy to venture out to Palau’s pristine dive sites, hidden lagoons, waterfalls and lush jungles. This immaculately preserved island is one of the planet’s best-kept natural gems.
